# x-biosignal

> Open-source R packages for biosignal analysis and rehabilitation research.

x-biosignal provides 37 public packages spanning data structures, acquisition,
preprocessing, physiological signals, biomechanics, clinical inference,
reproducibility, and reporting. R is the released implementation. Python and
Nextflow extensions are in development.

## Start

- [Documentation portal](https://x-biosignal.github.io/)
- [Quick Start](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioExperiment#quick-start)
- [R package index](https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev/packages)
- [MCP package catalog](https://github.com/x-biosignal/mcp-server-biosignal)
- [Support](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioExperiment/blob/main/SUPPORT.md)
- [Governance](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioExperiment/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md)
- [Citation](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioExperiment#citation)
